dogecoin.text:
It’s still early, but the actual IP of the most valuable meme in crypto sits at fractions of what the mainstream meme is worth.

Another actual Doge IP interpretation is trading at 11 Mio FDV vs the 34B for Dogecoin. Many cases like these in NFTs - this is underpriced attention.

The actual Doge NFT is about 0.35% of the Dogecoin market cap.

If our IP tokenization thesis (report upcoming) is right, then there is a very significant upside to close that valuation gap.

We will see how this plays out, but there lays an asymmetric opportunity in front of us.
